prohibited_inferences: Do not treat the v12 extension or PC-14 fixture as evidence that a named system institution source or signer was attacked or compromised.
Do not infer current semantic validity authorization or relevance from matching bytes or hashes alone.
Do not infer signer trust credential integrity or authorized content from a valid signature alone.
Do not infer a clean execution path from an eventual reference-correct result.
Do not infer successful recovery from detection quarantine rollback or replay without the full downstream receipts.
Do not infer absence of transient exposure residual harm or prior consequence from replay success or correction.
Do not infer exact proposal or implementation continuity from an unchanged family-level headline.
Do not infer clean provenance from missing alerts or incomplete detector coverage.
Do not infer attacker identity manipulation intent legitimacy or public injury from a provenance failure alone.
Do not treat the fourteen-control floor as exhaustive of every security epistemic constitutional social or performative failure mode.

interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A compositional successor floor that preserves the qualified thirteen-control v11 base and adds PC-14 provenance attack detection quarantine rollback replay correction abstention and recovery equifinality without rewriting the frozen base controls.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A real-world incident report attacker attribution security certification trustworthiness verdict manipulation finding public-authorization verdict named-system allegation or complete universal theory of provenance and recovery.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: Preference Custody floor v12 composes the qualified v11 controls with PC-14. It separates hashes signatures trust freshness detector alerts quarantine rollback replay correction transient exposure residual uncertainty and exact proposal state under one public headline, while requiring real cases to preserve complete artifact forensic recovery consequence correction and authority custody.
